column2: Elizabeth Nash (Lab){{efn|Nash had been a [[Kirkstall (ward)|Kirkstall]] ward councillor since [[Leeds City Council election, 1972|1972]].}}
column12: Elizabeth Nash (Lab){{efn|Nash did not stand at the [[Leeds City Council election, 1988|next election in 1988]]. She later won the [[1988 Leeds City Council election#By-elections between 1988 and 1990|1989 City & Holbeck ward by-election]] and, since the [[Leeds City Council election, 2018|2018 election]], has represented [[Hunslet and Riverside (ward)|Hunslet & Riverside]] ward. To date, except for between 1988 and 1989, Nash has sat as a councillor since [[Leeds City Council election, 1972|1972]], when she was first elected for [[Kirkstall (ward)|Kirkstall]] ward.}}

column2: Bernard Atha (Lab){{efn|Atha had previously represented [[Leeds city centre|City]] ward from [[Leeds City Council election, 1957|1957]] to [[Leeds City Council election, 1968|1968]], when he lost his bid to be re-elected to council for the new West [[Hunslet]] ward. He was then a councillor for [[Holbeck]] ward from [[Leeds City Council election, 1969|1969]] until his election for [[Kirkstall (ward)|Kirkstall]] ward in [[Leeds City Council election, 1973|1973]].}}

column5: John Hamilton (Con){{efn|After losing his re-election bid for [[Kirkstall (ward)|Kirkstall]] ward at the [[Leeds City Council election, 1979|next election in 1979]], Hamilton was later elected as a [[Weetwood (ward)|Weetwood]] ward councillor in [[Leeds City Council election, 1980|1980]] and held the seat until [[Leeds City Council election, 1990|1990]].}}
